title: Steven Orr Bought Amazon Into the Panic, Here’s Why
speaker: Steven Orr (Kase R Markets), interviewed by Chris

macro_themes.view: Last week's leveraged flush capitulated Friday; VIX easing makes it a good time to get back in, but a stock picker's market.
Expects Warsh's Fed not to hike at this week's meeting; maybe one hike in December.
Expects Democrats to take the House (maybe Senate) on Nov 3; gridlock brings clarity, good for markets.
AI and quantum threats make cybersecurity more needed, not obsolete.

calls.reason: Bought back in Friday at capitulation as QQQ hit its 100-day/200-day MA with selling volume drying up and VIX falling.
calls.quote: I'm telling you right now, this is a good chance to get back in

calls.reason: Thought Amazon was completely beaten up; bought heavily Thursday.
calls.quote: I thought Amazon was completely beaten up and and we got back into Amazon pretty heavily

calls.reason: Tightening launch cycles, satellites, spectrum, Texas data center, Musk's confidence before earnings; long-term $20T potential.
calls.quote: I think this stock is not where we are now at 150. I think we're closer to 160, 170 in December

calls.reason: Cybersecurity thesis plus beaten-down chart; linear regression suggests gains ~3 months out.
calls.quote: you're going to be a happy camper come about 3 months from now

calls.reason: Says AT&T can push up over the next few months.
calls.quote: I really think that AT&T can really push up here over the next uh few months

notes: Dated Monday 2026-10-19 ('Sunday night, yesterday'). SpaceX ticker unknown post-IPO; recorded as SPACEX. Medium target 170 taken from '160, 170 in December'.
